base_dir.description: Base directory where netscript stores runtime data, state, and generated scripts.

script_dir.description: Directory where custom network scripts are stored and executed from.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug output to stderr when running netscript commands.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent script executions allowed at once.

timeout.description: Default timeout (in seconds) for script execution before it is killed.

log_to_syslog.description: Whether to send log messages to the system logger (syslog).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., local0 through local7).

namespaces.description: List of network namespaces to configure and manage.

name.description: Unique name for the network namespace (e.g., 'dmz', 'mgmt').

iface.description: Host interface to attach to this namespace (e.g., 'eth1').

ip.description: Static IPv4 address to assign to the namespace interface (e.g., '10.0.1.1'). Leave empty to disable static IP.

netmask.description: Subnet mask for the namespace interface.

gateway.description: Gateway IP for the namespace interface. Leave empty if not routing.

dns.description: List of DNS servers for this namespace (e.g., ['8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.1']). If empty, falls back to DEFAULT_DNS.

enabled.description: Whether this namespace is active and should be created on startup.

default_dns.description: Default DNS servers used when a namespace doesn’t specify its own DNS list.

use_systemd.description: Enable integration with systemd for service management (e.g., auto-restart of scripts).

cleanup_on_shutdown.description: Whether to automatically remove all network namespaces and associated interfaces on service shutdown.
